name: adtest_dwtest
setup: n = 200; x_uniform_grid = ((1:n)' - 0.5) / n; x_normal_inv = sqrt(2) * erfinv(2 * x_uniform_grid - 1); x_exp_inv = -log(x_uniform_grid); r_smooth = sin((1:n)' * 0.05); X = [ones(n, 1), (1:n)']; rng(7); r_pos = zeros(n, 1); r_pos(1) = randn(); for i = 2:n; r_pos(i) = 0.8 * r_pos(i-1) + 0.2 * randn(); end;
expr: [h_n, p_n, A2_n, cv_n] = adtest(x_normal_inv); [h_e, p_e, A2_e, ~] = adtest(x_exp_inv); [p_s, dw_s] = dwtest(r_smooth, X); [p_pos, dw_pos] = dwtest(r_pos, X);
comment: Sig: [h, p, A2*, cv] = adtest(x [, alpha]) — Anderson-Darling normality test with estimated parameters. A² statistic via the standard order-statistic formula, Stephens-1986 small-sample adjustment, p-value via the D'Agostino-Stephens piecewise rational fit. Critical value cv = 0.752 (α = 0.05). [p, dw] = dwtest(r, X) — Durbin-Watson autocorrelation test on regression residuals. DW = Σ(r_i - r_{i-1})² / Σ r_i². p-value now via the EXACT distribution (Imhof CF inversion of the residual-space MAM eigenvalues), matching MATLAB's default 'exact' method (fixed 2026-06-05, bugs/stats/dwtest-pvalue.md; deterministic exact-value validation lives in tools/parity/specs/dwtest_exact.json). Bit-exact MATLAB R2025b not feasible HERE (rng state in r_pos); this spec pins structural invariants only (decision, sign of dw deviation, critical value).
